name: RC-B10-0411/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the September 2025 massacre in Cabaret, where gangs killed over 40 people, and the wider gang violence in Haiti. It asks the European Union and its member states to send more humanitarian aid, including food and healthcare, and to help rebuild Haiti's courts so criminals face justice. It also wants sanctions on gang leaders, action to stop weapons reaching Haiti, and better support for a new international security force.

- The EU is asked to give more aid and help reform Haiti's justice system; this affects Haitians facing hunger and violence.
- The EU should sanction gang leaders and curb arms flows; this affects gangs and Haiti's neighbours.
- The EU should back a new security force with funding and rights safeguards; next, member states decide on support.
